verdict.rationale: Modal publishes its client SDK source (Python, plus JS and Go SDKs) in a public GitHub repository, modal-labs/modal-client, so part of the product's source can be read. Nothing in the pack names a license, and the core serverless platform is not shown to be open. missing for 10: evidence of an open license (e.g., Apache/MIT) on the repo, source availability for the platform/backend beyond the client SDKs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The [Modal](https://modal.com/) Python SDK allows you to deploy high-performance serverless applications and programmatically interact with the Modal platform.
The JS and Go SDKs allow you to use Modal Sandboxes, invoke deployed Modal Functions, and interact with some Modal platform resources.
